annotations.title: Solana Token Facts: Authorities, Supply, Holder Concentration

description: Verifiable on-chain facts about a Solana token mint: whether the mint and freeze authorities are still set, total supply, decimals, token program, and how much of the supply the largest token accounts hold, plus public market metrics from a token index. Facts only: no verdict and no recommendation. Largest accounts can be liquidity pools or exchanges, not individual holders. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
name: solana_token_facts
